name: vqa_caption
description: Visual Question Answering and image captioning for remote sensing imagery. Answers natural language questions about a single satellite image or generates descriptive captions, computed from real spectral land-cover statistics (classical CV, not a trained VLM).

image_path.description: Path to the input satellite image (GeoTIFF, PNG, or JPEG)

question.description: Natural language question about the image, or 'caption' for a descriptive caption

modality.description: Sensor modality of the input image (used only for labeling the answer)

raw_confidence.description: Confidence score [0,1], derived from how far the estimate sits from an ambiguous decision boundary
